body: Suresh, Corporate aur bulk lunch orders ke liye customer draft Indiranagar mein: “Office lunch plan kar rahe hain? Mylari South Indian Cafe par Weekday Lunch Thali @ ₹149 listed hai. Bulk quote ke liye headcount, date, veg/Jain requirements aur delivery location bhejiye.” Ek detail badalni ho toh bhejiye, ya draft theek ho toh APPROVE likhiye.
rationale: Existing planning intent gets actual proposed copy; package prices and capacity are not inferred from unrelated listing offers.

body: Padma, Proposed pilot for Mylapore: a structured 4-week kids yoga block, grouped by age, with instructor-confirmed capacity. Interest-check draft: “Zen Yoga Studio is exploring a kids yoga group. Send your child's age and preferred weekday timing; we will share the proposed schedule and details.” Reply with the one detail to change, or APPROVE to keep this draft.
rationale: Existing planning intent gets actual proposed copy; package prices and capacity are not inferred from unrelated listing offers.

body: Hi Aditya, Karim's Salon here. Your salon appointment is confirmed for tomorrow. Karim is getting your slot ready. Reply CONFIRM if you can attend, or RESCHEDULE to pick another time.
rationale: Next-day reminder sent on behalf of the merchant, with warm personal greeting, chair/slot preparation, and one two-way CTA.

body: Hi Riya, Beauty Lounge by Renu se. Kal aapki salon appointment confirmed hai. Renu aapka slot ready rakh rahe hain. Aa sakte hain toh CONFIRM bhejiye, ya doosra time lene ke liye RESCHEDULE likhiye.
rationale: Next-day reminder sent on behalf of the merchant, with warm personal greeting, chair/slot preparation, and one two-way CTA.

body: Ramesh, summer 2026 wala shift shuru ho chuka hai: ORS demand +40%, sunscreen demand +38%, antifungal demand +45%, aur cold cough demand -60%. Malviya Nagar mein yeh decide karta hai ki log pehle kya maangenge — discount nahi. Aapki listing pe pichhle 30 din mein 1,850 views, 38 calls aur 4.5% click rate hai, toh upar jo dikhta hai woh sach mein dekha jaata hai. Main agle chaar hafton ke liye ek page ki shelf aur counter priority list bana doon (sirf 2 min lagenge review karne mein)? YES bhejiye, ya STOP.
rationale: Concrete seasonal demand movements translated into an operator decision, anchored on the merchant's own visibility numbers.

body: Dr. Meera, aapki Lajpat Nagar practice ke liye ek session hai jiske liye time block karna banta hai — IDA Delhi: Digital impressions — 2026 state of the art, 2 May, 7pm ko, 2 CDE credits, members ke liye free. IDA Delhi chapter calendar ne list kiya hai. Main registration ke steps aur ek calendar block ek hi message mein bhej doon, taaki clinic hours mein miss na ho? YES bhejiye, ya STOP.
rationale: Time-bound professional opportunity with date, credits, fee and source, without inventing seat scarcity and a single scheduling action.

body: Namaste Mr. Sharma, Apollo Health Plus Pharmacy se. Aapki monthly medicines — metformin, atorvastatin, aur telmisartan — ka stock 28 Apr tak chalega. Active offer: Senior Citizen 15% OFF. Aapka delivery address saved hai. REFILL bhejiye, hum ready rakh denge — ya prescription badla ho toh CHANGE likhiye.
rationale: Exact molecules and run-out date from the record, saved-delivery state, and a confirmation CTA that also catches prescription changes.

body: Hi Vivaan, Dr. Sameer from Bright Smile Dental here. 🦷 As a regular patient (5 visits), your routine preventive check-up and oral hygiene maintenance cycle is due following your visit on 1 Apr — periodic clinical reviews keep your teeth and gums protected before issues begin. Reply YES to check consultation availability this week, or STOP to end reminders.
rationale: Clinical follow-up anchored on doctor's authority, patient visit history, oral hygiene maintenance lifecycle, and preventive dental care.

body: Dr. Meera, Smile Studio 8 Apr ko 1.3 km door khula hai, Dental Cleaning @ ₹199 ke saath. React karne se pehle: aapki listing par pichhle 30 din mein 2,410 views, 18 calls aur 2.1% click rate hai, aur Dental Cleaning @ ₹299 live hai. Price badalne se pehle included services aur apne costs compare kijiye. Main ek sharper listing comparison bana doon, aapki asli strength par? YES bhejiye, ya STOP.
rationale: Local competitive pressure answered with the merchant's own position, an explicit recommendation against a price war, and one specific ask.

body: Suresh, Indiranagar ke paas ek naya competitor khula hai. React karne se pehle: aapki listing par pichhle 30 din mein 12,400 views, 88 calls aur 3.2% click rate hai, aur Weekday Lunch Thali @ ₹149 live hai — yeh aapka solid customer base hai. Price war mein padne ke bajaye apni quality aur strengths par focus karein. Bas ek cheez bataiye jo woh sabse zyada push kar rahe hain — price, timing, ya koi service jo aap list nahi karte — main aapki strength par listing ka jawaab draft kar dungi. Woh ek detail reply kijiye, ya STOP.
rationale: Local competitive pressure answered with the merchant's own position, an explicit recommendation against a price war, and one specific ask.

body: Lakshmi, ek quick check — aapki listing par pichhle 30 din mein 4,980 views, 62 calls aur 4.8% click rate hai aur Haircut @ ₹99 live hai. Is hafte customers kaunsi service maang rahe hain jo aapki list mein nahi hai? Ek cheez reply kar dijiye (30 second ka kaam hai), main aaj hi post draft bana dungi; aur kuch nahi chahiye.
rationale: Asks the merchant something only they know, priced at one word of effort, with the merchant's real numbers as the reason for asking.

Your listing has 5,934 views, 65 calls and 4.2% click rate in the last 30 days. Want me to draft a high-energy workout challenge or trial post to pack your floor slots? Reply YES, or STOP.

body: Vikas, Sunrise Medicos abhi tak Google par unverified hai. Unverified hote hue bhi listing par pichhle 30 din mein 720 views, 14 calls aur 4.1% click rate hai — yaani demand badge ke bina bhi aa rahi hai. Verify karne ke baad estimate: 30% zyada visibility, postcard or phone call se. Yeh estimate hai, pakka gain nahi; verification method aur timing Google decide karta hai. Main teen exact steps ek message mein bhej doon? YES bhejiye, ya STOP.
rationale: Quantified listing gap with the supplied uplift estimate and verification route, framed as a small effort against demand the merchant is already earning.

body: Suresh, DC vs MI — 26 Apr, 7:30pm. Sunday evening match ke dauran food delivery aur match snack combos ki demand peak par hoti hai. Aapki listing par pichhle 30 din mein 2,200 views, 12 calls aur 2% click rate hai. Match shuru hone se pehle delivery orders lock karne ke liye post draft bana sakte hain. Cutoff time bhejiye, uske hisaab se post draft kar dungi.
rationale: Uses the actual match date and peak delivery timing; requests only the missing operational cutoff.

rationale: Names the exact weak metric with its real value, separates seasonality from decline, and offers one category-correct recovery action.

rationale: Recall built entirely on the supplied service, dates, open slots, and active perks with an easy opt-out.

Your complimentary studio perk — Free Body Fitness Analysis — is waiting on the mat. Reply YES and we will hold a mat slot for you this week, or STOP if you would rather not be reminded.

body: Dr. Meera, Dental Council of India circular 2026-11-04 se ek compliance update: Maximum dose per IOPA exposure drops from 1.5 mSv to 1.0 mSv. E-speed film passes at the new limit; D-speed does not. Digital RVG sensors unaffected. Yeh 15 Dec se effective hai. Audit your X-ray setup before Dec 15; document E-speed or RVG in your SOPs. Aapki Lajpat Nagar practice mein equipment check aur front-desk explanation consistent rakhein. Main team ke liye audit checklist bana doon? YES bhejiye, ya STOP.
rationale: Source-cited regulation with the exact effective date, connected to the merchant's own listing traffic, resolved by one compliance artifact.
